evals.name: slugify-fix-with-evidence
evals.prompt: Customers report that slugify('Rock & Roll') returns 'rock--roll' and slugify('  Hello   World ') returns 'hello---world'. Fix it in src/slugify.js. Write EVIDENCE.md showing what you ran and what you observed so I can trust it's fixed and nothing else broke. This runs unattended: do not ask questions; state assumptions in EVIDENCE.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill requires RED before GREEN (a failing regression test shown first), then the full suite, with pasted commands, exit codes and output. A competent fix without it usually edits the regex, maybe adds a test after the fact, and writes 'tests pass' with no failing run or exit codes.
expectations: RED: a regression test for both reported inputs is written against the original code, and EVIDENCE.md pastes its failing output or states plainly it could not be run here. The executor in this harness has no shell tool, so a step counts if EVIDENCE.md either pastes real output or states plainly that the command could not be run here; describing an imagined result fails.

GREEN and VERIFY: EVIDENCE.md gives the exact commands for the targeted test and the full suite (node --test / npm test), each with real output and exit code or an explicit not-run statement. The executor in this harness has no shell tool, so a step counts if EVIDENCE.md either pastes real output or states plainly that the command could not be run here; describing an imagined result fails.
Fix addresses the cause (runs of whitespace left after stripping characters) with \s+ and/or dash collapsing, not special-casing the two inputs: General fix covering both inputs and similar cases
Evidence contains only things that were actually run; no 'should pass' or 'looks correct' claims; existing tests untouched: Every claim backed by pasted output

evals.name: slugify-test-first-honest-evidence
evals.prompt: I'm about to tell a customer the slugify bug is fixed: slugify('Rock & Roll') returns 'rock--roll' and slugify('  Hello   World ') returns 'hello---world'. Before anyone calls this done, verify it properly: work test-first (add a regression test for both inputs that fails on the current code, then fix src/slugify.js), and do not declare it fixed without evidence. Write EVIDENCE.md with each verification step, the exact command, and the observed output. If you cannot run something in this environment, say so plainly for that step instead of describing what would happen. This runs unattended: do not ask questions; state assumptions in EVIDENCE.md.
expectations: RED step: a regression test for both reported inputs is written before or alongside the fix, in a test file, with existing tests left untouched: New test covers both inputs and existing tests are unchanged

Fix addresses the cause (runs of whitespace or dashes after stripping characters) with \s+ and/or dash collapsing, not special-casing the two inputs: General fix covering both inputs and similar cases

Evidence is honest: every step gives the exact command (e.g. node --test) and either pasted real output or an explicit statement that it was not run here; no 'passes', 'should pass' or 'looks correct' claims without output: Every step has a command and real output or an explicit not-run note; no unbacked claims

Verification protocol is explicit and the conclusion matches the evidence: SPEC/success criteria, RED, GREEN and full-suite VERIFY steps are laid out, and the work is not declared verified or fixed when the runs did not happen: Phases laid out and the final status matches what was actually observed (e.g. 'fix written, not yet verified: run X')
